developmentChanges.title: Proposal competition-adjusted value
developmentChanges.reason: For freelance jobs, combine hourly/fixed economics with proposal count, hires and interviewing count so apparently good budgets do not outrank opportunities with materially better win probability.

developmentChanges.title: Client view recency decay
developmentChanges.reason: Apply a continuous recency penalty from the client's last-view timestamp rather than only a binary stale flag, prioritizing jobs where the buyer is demonstrably active now.
